name: breadcrumbs
summary: Renders a labelled breadcrumb trail of safe linked ancestors and one current page.

agent.useWhen: A page has a navigable hierarchy with one or more ancestor destinations and a current location.
agent.avoidWhen: The trail is not hierarchical, the current item must be a link, or destinations are not safe internal/HTTP(S) hrefs.

invariants: At least one linked ancestor is followed by exactly one nonlinked current page.
Ancestor hrefs use the closed safe destination policy; labels and href attributes are escaped.
All labels are nonblank plain text; no arbitrary URLs, HTML, routes, or scripts are admitted.
The fragment contains exactly one [[attributes]], [[label]], and [[items]] slot; expansion is exact and single-pass.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-breadcrumbs-gap
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Controls spacing between elements for breadcrumbs.

rules: Only direct cui-crumb helpers are allowed; no loops, conditionals, or other markup in the trail.

attributes.name: label
rules: A literal or one whole checked string field; must be nonblank plain text.

attributes.name: href
rules: Required for ancestors; use a safe internal literal destination or one whole named route call.

attributes.name: current
rules: If present, must be literal true; current crumb cannot have href.
Provide one or more linked ancestors followed by exactly one current crumb, which must be last and have no href.
At least one ancestor and exactly one current item are required.
Host route registration, route argument/type checks, destination safety, and final template admission remain host-owned; this metadata does not authorize arbitrary routes or URLs.
Labels and destinations are emitted as escaped text and attributes.

examples.name: customer-trail
examples.summary: A customer detail breadcrumb with a linked list ancestor and a current customer.
examples.template:
<cui-breadcrumbs label="Breadcrumb">
  <cui-crumb label="Customers" href="{{ routes.customers_index() }}" />
  <cui-crumb label="{{ customer.name }}" current="true" />
</cui-breadcrumbs>
requirements: Register customers_index route if using the ancestor link.
App provides customer.name as a nonblank string field.
